params.default: The earlier version takes the place of the one you have now. The one you have now is not lost - it moves into Earlier versions, so you can switch back the same way.

params.name: vr_done
params.default: The earlier version is back. The one it replaced is under Earlier versions.

params.name: ap_check_image
params.default: Check each picture after it is made

params.name: ap_check_video
params.default: Check each clip after it is made

params.name: ap_check_note
params.default: about {each} more per picture: an AI looks at it against what was asked (how many of each character, animals as animals, no stray words); a wrong one is redrawn once by itself (paid again), still wrong = marked Needs a look. Untick to get pictures straight away, as before.

params.default: about {each} more per clip: an AI looks at a frame against what was asked; a wrong clip is marked Needs a look (never remade by itself - that would pay for the clip again).

params.name: ck_ok
params.default: Checked: it matches what was asked

params.name: as_make_body
params.default: Its story text becomes the source of the new one - free, and nothing here changes. Then carry on there: script, pictures, voice.

params.default: The portal was just updated - the next screen you open loads the new version.
